To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mRNA for the metalloproteinase-inducer EMMPPRIN and for the metalloprotease MMP-2 is expressed in malignant fibrous histioctyoma (MFH) and aggressive fibromatoma (AF).
malignant fibrous histiocytes, aggressive fibromatose and benign fibrous tumors express mRNA for the metalloproteinase MMP-2 and its inducer EMMPRIN.
malignant fibrous histioctomas, aggressive fibromatoses and benign fibrous tumors express mRNA for the metalloproteinase-inducer EMMPRI, and the metalloprotein-ases MMP-2, and MT1-MP.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the activation and expression of the MMP-inducer, the matrix metalloprotein-ase inducer, the matrix metal- loproteinases and their inhibitor, the tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases in mesenchymales tumours with different tendencies to recurrence or metastasis.

the expression and distribution of the mRNA for the metalloproteinase-inducer EMMP RIN and the matrix metalloprotein-2 and membrane-type 2 metalloproteinase in malignant fibrous histio cytoma, aggressive fibromatose and benign fibrous tumor.
the role of EMMPRINS in the development of malignant mesenchymal neoplasms and the possibility of using EMMPRIN as a marker of tumor aggressiveness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EMMPRIN/MMP-2/MMP-14 system seems to be involved in the invasion and metastasis of mesenchymal neoplasms.
the expression of EMMPRin and MMP-2 is associated with the tumor aggressiveness and metastatic potential of the mesenchymal tumor.
EMMPRIn, MMP-2, and MT1-MP mRNA-expression is frequently found in mesenchymall tumors, and that the expression of these mRNAs may be related to the tendency for recurrence and/or metastases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EMMPRin, MMP-2, and MT1-MP are expressed in the tumor cells and the endothelial cells of the pseudo-capsule of MFH, AF, and BF.
the mRNA for the inducer EMMPRIN as well as the mRNAs for the metalloproteinase MMP-2 are frequently expressed in mesenchyma tumors.
the expression of EMMPRIn, MMP-2, and MT1-Mmp are up-regulated in MFH compared with AF and BF.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression of MMP-2 is related to the tumor type.
EMMPRIn and MMP-2 are expressed in mesenchymale tumors with different degrees of malignancy.
the EMMPRIN-MMP-2-MT1-MMP system is a common feature in mesenchymmal tumors, and that EMMPRINS and MMPs can be used as markers of tumor progression and aggressiveness.
